_note: SEALED answer key for the blind test of unit U-300 (export gas compressor K-301 with suction scrubber V-301, aftercooler E-301, anti-surge recycle, lube oil and seal gas). ALL DATA IS SYNTHETIC; not a real facility. Written by scripts/make_dummy_batch3.py, which builds every document from one consistent design and applies each planted item as one named override, then reads the evidence cells back from the files. Expected on load and not discrepancies in themselves: (1) the LOPA loader reports the LAH-3003 row of the IPL sheet as skipped, 'listed, not credited' (clean control CC3-06); (2) the configuration loader reports the MOS-3xxx override switches as configured-only points and PAH-3006 (item B3-23) as a new alarm; (3) PT-3033 is on a drawing and configured but not in the index (item B3-17); (4) HS-3001, PSV-3050 and XY-3040 are in the index with a P&ID number but are not in the topology CSV, because that format would read push-button, relief valve and relay tags as equipment: a finding that these three are 'not on a drawing' is an artefact of the format, neither planted nor a fair false alarm; (5) with no PDF, P&ID revisions are unknown to the loaders. Several items touch the same function (for example SIF-300-05: B3-07, B3-11, B3-15, B3-21; the PT-3012A override in B3-09 depends on an alarm that is itself shelved). A finding that states the consequence of two planted items together should be credited to both. Timestamps: configuration export 2026-11-12 06:00.

items.kind: voting as configured
items.finding: SIF-300-06 is 1oo2 on PT-3007A/B in the C&E, the SRS and the SIL verification, but the logic solver is configured 2oo2, so one failed transmitter defeats the trip.

items.kind: final element missing from the configured trip
items.finding: SIF-300-01 must trip K-301 through XY-3040 and close XV-3001 (C&E, SRS, SIL verification), but the configured trip drives XY-3040 only; XV-3001 is not closed.
evidence: U300-CE-CHART-Rev-C.xlsx:CE-300:L6 = X (XV-3001 column, row of LT-3002A)

items.kind: change closed on paper, not made in the plant
items.finding: MOC-2026-053 (closed) lowered the SIF-300-03 trip from 85 to 82 barg and the SRS and C&E say 82 barg, but the logic solver still trips at 85 barg.
evidence: U300-MOC-REG-Rev-A.xlsx:Register:B7 = Lower the SIF-300-03 discharge pressure trip from 85 to 82 barg (discharge system re-rated after inspection)

items.kind: calculation rests on a superseded proof test interval
items.finding: MOC-2026-055 (closed) extended the XV-3001 proof test interval to 24 months and the SRS says so, but the SIL verification still assumes 12 months and was not revised; at 24 months SIF-300-01 achieves about RRF 70 against a target of 100.
evidence: U300-SRS-001-Rev-C.xlsx:SIF Requirements:N4 = Sensors 12 months, XY-3040 12 months, XV-3001 24 months

items.kind: LOPA requirement not carried into the SRS
items.finding: The revalidated LOPA requires SIL 2 / RRF 100 of SIF-300-02 (scenario S-300-02), but the SRS and the C&E still specify SIL 1 (RRF 10) and the SIL verification achieves only RRF 91.

items.kind: credited alarm not independent of the initiating event
items.finding: LOPA scenario S-300-06 credits PAL-3006 (PFD 0.1), but PAL-3006 is generated from PT-3006, the transmitter of the PIC-3006 loop whose failure is the initiating event; without the credit SIF-300-06 would need RRF 200, not 20.

items.kind: alarm relied on as protection is set beyond the trip point
items.finding: PAL-3021 (credited IPL in S-300-05, compensating measure and SRS bypass condition for SIF-300-05) is rationalised at 1.5 barg but configured at 0.7 barg, below the 0.8 barg trip, so it cannot annunciate before the trip.

items.kind: bypass closed on paper, still active in the plant
items.finding: MOC-2026-057 and out-of-service entry OOS-300-0010 record the TT-3014B bypass as restored and closed on 2026-11-04, but MOS-3014B is still active in the configuration export of 2026-11-12 06:00 (since 2026-11-04 08:00, about 190 h against 8 h), leaving SIF-300-04 on one transmitter with no live record.

items.kind: compensating alarm out of service while the channel is bypassed
items.finding: PT-3012A is overridden (OOS-300-0012) with compensating measures recorded as confirmed and PAH-3013 noted as active, but PAH-3013 has been shelved since 2026-11-10 with PT-3013 isolated (OOS-300-0011); PAH-3013 is the only approved compensating measure and the SRS bypass condition for SIF-300-03, and a credited IPL in S-300-03.
evidence: out_of_service_U-300.csv:row 4:reason = PT-3013 impulse line leak; transmitter isolated, reading frozen
out_of_service_U-300.csv:row 5:notes = PAH-3013 confirmed active before the override was set
U300-SRS-001-Rev-C.xlsx:SIF Requirements:O6 = One channel at a time, with PAH-3013 confirmed active; max 8 h

items.kind: safety function implemented in the control system
items.finding: SIF-300-02 is assigned to the logic solver SIS-LS-300 in the C&E, SRS, SIL verification and index, but it is configured in the DCS controller DCS-300-C01, with LT-3005 and XV-3003 wired to DCS I/O; it is not independent of the BPCS level loop whose failure is its demand.

items.kind: two channels of one function overridden together
items.finding: PT-3020B and PT-3020C are both overridden at the export time (MOS-3020B and MOS-3020C active; OOS-300-0014 and OOS-300-0015 overlap), but the SRS allows only one channel of SIF-300-05 at a time and the SIL verification covers one bypassed channel only; the trip rests on PT-3020A alone.
evidence: U300-SRS-001-Rev-C.xlsx:SIF Requirements:O8 = One channel at a time, with PAL-3021 confirmed active; max 8 h

items.kind: removed alarm still relied on
items.finding: LAL-3003 was removed under MOC-2026-058 (MADB 'Removed', no longer configured), but it is still the SRS bypass condition and the approved compensating measure for SIF-300-02 and is still listed in the alarm register; the MOC did not list the SRS or the compensating measures register and the alarm register was not revised.
evidence: U300-CFG-EXPORT-Rev-A.xlsx:Alarms: no row with Alarm Tag = LAL-3003
U300-SRS-001-Rev-C.xlsx:SIF Requirements:O5 = Not permitted unless LAL-3003 is confirmed active and an operator is stationed at LG-3004; max 2 h

items.kind: range of one voted transmitter differs
items.finding: LT-3002C is configured 0-1500 mm while the index gives 0-2000 mm (as LT-3002A/B are configured); the SIF-300-01 trip point of 1500 mm is at the top of that channel's configured range.

items.kind: calculation uses the wrong sensor
items.finding: The SIL verification of SIF-300-04 takes TT-3014A and TT-3015 as the 1oo2 sensor pair; TT-3015 is the BPCS transmitter. The C&E and the configured trip use TT-3014A and TT-3014B.

items.kind: records disagree on when a bypass began
items.finding: The out-of-service register starts the PT-3020C override at 2026-11-12 04:00 (2 h before the export), but the logic solver shows MOS-3020C active since 2026-11-10 16:00: 38 h at the export against the 8 h limit, which the register does not show.
evidence: U300-SRS-001-Rev-C.xlsx:SIF Requirements:O8 = One channel at a time, with PAL-3021 confirmed active; max 8 h

items.kind: unit conversion error in a configured limit
items.finding: PDAL-3030 is rationalised at 0.5 bar (50 kPa) but configured at 5 kPa on a point scaled 0-200 kPa: a factor of ten low, so the seal gas differential pressure alarm will not annunciate until the differential is almost lost.

items.kind: installed instrument missing from the index
items.finding: PT-3033 (MOC-2026-054, implemented) is on PID-300-003 and configured in the DCS, but it is not in the instrument index, which the MOC lists as still to be revised.
evidence: U300-INST-INDEX-Rev-D.xlsx:Instrument Index: no row with Tag No. = PT-3033

items.kind: document recorded as revised but not revised
items.finding: MOC-2026-056 (closed) raised LAH-3003 from 1100 to 1200 mm and records the alarm register as revised; the MADB and the configuration say 1200 mm but the alarm register still says 1100 mm.

items.kind: rationalised alarm not configured
items.finding: FAH-3032 (primary seal vent flow high, High priority) is in the MADB as implemented and in the alarm register, but no such alarm is configured.
evidence: U300-CFG-EXPORT-Rev-A.xlsx:Alarms: no row with Alarm Tag = FAH-3032

items.kind: credited operator response slower than the time available
items.finding: The LOPA credits TAH-3015 in S-300-04 on the basis that 10 min are available between the alarm and the trip point, but the MADB rationalises TAH-3015 with a time to respond of 30 min.
evidence: U300-LOPA-001-Rev-B.xlsx:IPLs:D10 = High discharge temperature alarm on TT-3015, operator reduces load or trips the machine; 10 min available between the alarm and the trip point

items.kind: calculation cites a superseded target
items.finding: The SIL verification takes the SIF-300-05 target from SRS Rev B (RRF 10); the current SRS Rev C and the LOPA require RRF 20. The achieved RRF still exceeds both.
evidence: U300-SRS-001-Rev-C.xlsx:SIF Requirements:A2 = Document No. U300-SRS-001    Rev C    Status: As Built    (DUMMY DATA - not a real facility)

items.kind: change made before approval
items.finding: MOC-2026-060 (in review, not approved) proposes raising the TAH-3016 on-delay from 10 s to 60 s; the configuration already has 60 s while the MADB has 10 s.

items.kind: configured alarm never rationalised
items.finding: PAH-3006 (PT-3006, 32 barg, Low) is configured in the DCS but is in neither the MADB nor the alarm register.
evidence: U300-MADB-001-Rev-B.xlsx:Alarms: no row with Alarm Tag = PAH-3006
U300-INST-INDEX-Rev-D.xlsx:Alarm Register: no row with Alarm Tag = PAH-3006

items.kind: instrument location differs between index and drawing
items.finding: The index places TT-3008 on L-302 (compressor suction, downstream of V-301); the P&ID extraction shows it on L-301, upstream of the scrubber.

items.kind: document register out of date
items.finding: The document register lists the cause & effect chart U300-CE-CHART at Rev B; the chart in use is Rev C (re-issued under MOC-2026-053).

clean_controls.description: SIF-300-05 trip setpoint: 0.8 barg in the C&E and the configuration, 80 kPag in the SRS.
clean_controls.why_consistent: 80 kPa is 0.8 bar; the same value in another unit.

clean_controls.description: SIF-300-01 trip setpoint: 1500 mm in the C&E and the configuration, 1.5 m in the SRS.

PDT-3023 and PDAH-3023: index range 0-2.5 bar and alarm 1 bar (register, MADB) against a configured range of 0-250 kPa, limit 100 kPa and deadband 5 kPa. The configured range of PDT-3030 (0-200 kPa against 0-2 bar) and the PDAL-3030 deadband are the same kind.
clean_controls.why_consistent: Correct conversions at 100 kPa per bar. Only the PDAL-3030 limit (B3-16) is wrong.

clean_controls.description: LT-3002B overridden: MOS-3002B active since 2026-11-12 01:30, out-of-service entry OOS-300-0013 active from 01:30 to 09:30.
clean_controls.why_consistent: One channel of a 2oo3 function, 4.5 h at the export against the 8 h limit, authorised, the times agree between the register and the logic solver, and the compensating alarm LAH-3003 is configured, enabled and not shelved.

clean_controls.description: MOC-2026-052 proposed lowering the SIF-300-04 trip from 175 to 165 degC; every document and the configuration still say 175 degC and no document was revised.
clean_controls.why_consistent: The change was cancelled, so nothing should have changed.

clean_controls.description: LAH-3003 is listed in the LOPA IPL sheet for S-300-01 with no PFD, and is marked 'IPL Credit: No' in the MADB, yet it is the approved compensating measure and the SRS bypass condition for SIF-300-01.
clean_controls.why_consistent: A deliberate non-credit: the alarm shares LT-3003 with the initiating loop, so the LOPA takes no credit and the required RRF of 100 is calculated without it. It is independent of the SIS transmitters, which is what a compensating measure for a bypassed SIS channel needs.

clean_controls.description: PT-3011 remark says it was re-ranged from 0-100 to 0-120 barg; MOC-2026-050.
clean_controls.why_consistent: Closed properly: index and configuration both say 0-120 barg and the one document to revise was revised.
Closed on paper and in the plant: MOS-3007B is not active, the entry is closed, 6.2 h against the 8 h limit.

clean_controls.description: VAH-3017B is disabled in the configuration while the MADB says implemented.
clean_controls.why_consistent: A recorded, in-date temporary state: MOC-2026-059 (implemented, expires 2026-11-19) and out-of-service entry OOS-300-0016 (active to 2026-11-19). The alarm is not credited in the LOPA and is nobody's compensating measure; VAH-3017A remains in service.

clean_controls.description: SIF-300-03, -04, -05 and -06 achieve a higher SIL band in the SIL verification than their target; PAH-3011 (75 barg) and PAH-3013 (76 barg) are two high pressure alarms on the discharge with different limits.
clean_controls.why_consistent: Exceeding a target is not a discrepancy; the two alarms are on different transmitters (PT-3011 anti-surge, PT-3013 monitoring) and every document gives each the same limit.
